upload.label: Token tal-utent
help: Fuq api.slack.com/apps, oħloq app mill-bidu fil-workspace tiegħek.

Taħt OAuth & Permissions, żid dawn l-iscopes tat-token tal-utent: channels:read, groups:read, im:read, mpim:read, channels:history, groups:history, im:history, mpim:history, search:read, users:read, users:read.email, chat:write, im:write, reactions:write. Imbagħad installaha (forsi l-admin tal-workspace ikollu japprovaha).
Ikkopja l-User OAuth Token (jibda b'xoxp-) u waħħlu hawn.
